usage: Tensor2Bin.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] [--tensor_fn TENSOR_FN]
                     [--candidate_details_fn_prefix CANDIDATE_DETAILS_FN_PREFIX]
                     --var_fn VAR_FN --bin_fn BIN_FN [--bed_fn BED_FN]
                     [--shuffle] [--allow_duplicate_chr_pos]

Combine the variant and non-variant tensors and convert them to a binary

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --tensor_fn TENSOR_FN
                        Tensor input
  --candidate_details_fn_prefix CANDIDATE_DETAILS_FN_PREFIX
                        Candidate details input (unused, retained for
                        compatibility)
  --var_fn VAR_FN       Truth variants list input, required
  --bin_fn BIN_FN       Output a binary tensor file, required
  --bed_fn BED_FN       High confident genome regions input in the BED format
  --shuffle             Shuffle the inputs
  --allow_duplicate_chr_pos
                        Allow duplicated chromosome:position in the tensor
                        input
